notes.title: Update on Night Life VR – New Name, New Plans
notes.notes:
Apologies for the delay and thank you for your patience. Night Life VR was originally scheduled for release on December 24th, 2024. However, I made the decision to postpone the launch in order to continue refining the app, add more features, and ensure a smooth, bug-free experience.

As a solo developer, this project has taken a bit more time to pull together—but I'm excited to share that the app will now be launching in five stages during its early access phase.

Alongside this, there will be a rebrand: the app will now be called "Night Life – Clubbing in the Metaverse". I’ve decided to drop the “VR” from the title since the app will now support both VR and non-VR modes, with full support for keyboard/mouse and Xbox controllers.

Here’s the updated rollout plan:

Stage 1 (June): Solo mode in flatscreen (non-VR), offering a preview of the app’s features—think of it as a demo. Also in this stage of the release there will be brand new screenshots, trailer and the name change. The website for the app will also be relaunching.

Stage 2 (Mid-summer): Multiplayer features and more content added.

Stage 3 (End of summer): Full VR support goes live, alongside additional features.

Stage 4: A special DLC release.

Stage 5: This stage will remain a surprise—for now.

New promo images, screenshots, and a trailer will also be released soon to reflect the rebranding and updated features.

Thank you again for your support and for wishlisting the title—it truly means a lot!
